names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Zosima».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Ζωσιμάς», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 4 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Преп. Зосим“, with the rank word Преп. left off. The form is stored as the page prints it, Зосим and not Зосима; nothing was regularised. The heading leaves no epithet, and no other folder in the corpus holds a Serbian form of this spelling.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 4 апреля ст. ст., name page 852, «Зосима Палестинский, отшельник», with the grade word left off. The day’s own line declines the forename alone and then says what he is known for. No folder holds this form or the bare «Зосима», though eight folders read like him on the fold.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Зосимы , обретшего прп. Марию Египетскую в пустыне Иорданской (ок. 560).»

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Ζωσιμάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(460 - 560)». It names its own authority, Sophronius, archbishop of Jerusalem, and puts him in the reign of Justinian «(527 - 565 μ.Χ.)».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 17.04.2026 (4. април ст. ст.) — „Преп. Зосим“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and identified not by the name but by the deed: a monk of the Jordan community who found, communicated and buried Saint Mary of Egypt. **It takes the Romanian side of a disagreement this folder already carries**: it puts him in the time of the emperor Theodosius the Younger, which this folder's life records from the Romanian reading, against saint.gr's reign of Justinian — so the Prologue makes it two sources to one, and nothing was changed, because the dates this folder holds are saint.gr's 460 and 560 and a reign is not a year. Its two other numbers agree with those dates exactly: it has him repose „у својој стотој години“, in his hundredth year, and „у VI столећу“, in the sixth century, and 460 to 560 is a hundred years ending in that century. So nothing in `dates` was touched. The whole entry is four sentences and adds no incident the folder did not have. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. The stored form **Зосим** is what the heading prints, not Зосима, and it folds with nothing.

birth.note: saint.gr heads him «Οσιος Ζωσιμας (460 - 560)». The page gives no year in its prose; it says only that he lived in the reign of Justinian «(527 - 565 μ.Χ.)» and that he reposed «σε βαθύ γήρας», in deep old age.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Οσιος Ζωσιμας (460 - 560)» and closes «Ο Όσιος Ζωσιμάς κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη σε βαθύ γήρας», in deep old age, without naming a year in its prose.
